(10) Any operator who fails to comply with
determination  made  under  subsection  (8)  by
the  Commission  commits  an  offence  and  be
liable to a fine not exceeding ten million rupees
and in the event of the offence being committed
continuously,  to  an  additional  fine  of  three
hundred  thousand  rupees  for  each  day  on
which  the  offence  is  so  committed  after
conviction.
(11) Any operator who is aggrieved by the
determination under subsection (8), may appeal
against  such  determination  to  the  Court  of
